articles.title: Iran loses grip on Strait of Hormuz as US as Tehran calls on Americans to vote out Trump - Fox News
articles.description: Iran's economy remains crippled by sanctions and a U.S. blockade, leaving Tehran with few options now that its control over the Strait of Hormuz has slipped.
